protocol.recovery_definition: Left efficiency within 0.05 of 0.5 for 0.5 s; delay includes hold time.
protocol.median_definition: Unrecovered runs count as infinity; null means infinite median.
protocol.noise: Independent Gaussian speed and yaw-rate measurement noise; same numeric std, different units.
protocol.prediction_score: Noisy current state as input; true next state only as evaluation target.
protocol.assumptions: Known mass, inertia and drags; constant noiseless commands; no process noise or slip; no clipping.
